standard: Dual-authority Taiwan dictionary contract: CNS11643 Full Character Database owns radicals, total strokes, components and stroke order; MOE Mandarin Dictionary public data owns definitions and example words. Existing hand-curated local entries (25 characters) are preserved as-is and take priority; all other characters are sourced directly from CNS11643 official open data.

moeDictionary.downloadedFrom: https://github.com/g0v/moedict-data (dict-revised.json.xz, community JSON conversion of the MOE dictionary)
moeDictionary.note: meanings and exampleWords populated from real MOE single-character dictionary entries (161,194 total MOE entries, 11,327 single-character). 16,446 CNS-imported characters have no standalone MOE entry (rare/variant characters) and remain with empty meanings -- not fabricated placeholder text; falls back to the 19-radical curated imagery table (lib/nameology-radical-dictionary.ts) or a neutral generic line at render time. The 25 hand-curated entries keep their original naming-philosophy meanings/nameUsageNotes untouched; only gained real exampleWords/bopomofo where previously missing.
